newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: UAE's Oasis Leasing in initial public offering.
newsitem.headline: UAE's Oasis Leasing in initial public offering.

text.p: The new Oasis International Leasing Co said on Monday it was offering 27.5 million shares, or 55 percent of its authorised capital, at 10 dirhams each in an initial public offering to United Arab Emirates nationals.
Subscription would run from June 7 to June 19.
The IPO announcement said British Aerospace (BAe) has acquired a 13 percent stake in Oasis.
It said BAe was a "strategic partner" in the company, which will seek leasing deals in the oil-rich Gulf region.

The company said the founders -- including Abu Dhabi Investment Co, the Private Department of UAE President Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan, three Abu Dhabi-based national insurance companies, Dubai Investment Co and 20 members of the ruling al-Nahayan family -- contributed 45 percent to the company's capital.
